title: The White Tiger
author: Aravind Adiga
summary: Balram, a poor village boy turned driver, narrates his rise to success as a businessman in a letter to the visiting Chinese premier. He explains how he escaped the 'Rooster Coop' of servitude in India, and what it cost.
readIf: you like sharp, darkly funny novels about class and corruption in modern India.
skipIf: you want a sympathetic narrator or a story without cynicism.
